impact.rule: the most severe impact class with probability >= floor; 0.3 because a miss (understated severity) costs more than a false action (an extra owner report)

local_only.rule: lowers the level only at >= 0.7: wrongly lowering costs more than escalating

reached.rule: treated as unreached only at P(reached) <= 0.3 (P(unreached) >= 0.7)

minimums.reason: assumed per jev-actions: the owner gave none; recall raised to 0.9 because a missed high/critical costs more than an extra owner report

label_set.provenance: human: the owner reviewed all 56 cases one at a time on the label review page (https://claude.ai/artifact/WjwY8EcMvfAB34bMnCcuxs) and confirmed every agent_reviewed proposal unchanged (280 labels, none marked unsure). The proposals came from two blind sessions (opus, sonnet) that agreed on 280 of 280 labels from the frozen guide; both reasons are kept per label; 3 impact rule citations were corrected by adjudication (C40, C49, C54)
label_set.split: dev: C01-C44 (30 original replay cases plus 14 real advisories chosen to fill scarce labels); test: C45-C56, a natural sample of real advisories published 2026-10-28 or later (first per upstream repository, pip and npm alternating)

results.current: rubric severity matched the labels on 36/44 dev and 9/12 test; understated 1 dev (C34: reached scored 0.11 on an `open-webui serve` hit, so high became medium and the halt was missed) and 1 test (C45: impact read as data_exposure, medium became low, no halt change); overstated 7 dev, 2 test; halt decision (owner vs in-flow fix) matched 39/44 dev and 11/12 test
results.tuning: tune_threshold.py --min-precision 0.8 --min-recall 0.9: no threshold met the minimums for local_only (5 dev positives) or needs_interaction (8); needs_privileges tuned 0.58 (test P 0.75 R 1.00) and reached 0.325 (test P 0.71 R 1.00), both below the precision minimum on test; with --repeats 5 --conservative no question qualifies. The shipped values below are unchanged and stay provisional
results.malicious_rule: C30 (eslint-scope 3.7.2, alias MAL-GHSA-hxxf-q3w9-4xgw) never reaches the judgment: workflows.malicious_package routes it as critical to the owner
results.history: v2 (version 81dff5cf, 30 cases): 27/30 severity match; superseded by the reached rewording (R6) and the guide's new rules U4, I3, P3 and named defaults
